details.name: Claude Fable 5.1
details.meta: 2026.09 Release · Anthropic Proprietary · Autonomous Agentic Pioneer
details.desc: Anthropic's September 2026 flagship, leading both Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (66) and LMSYS Arena (1520 Elo). Pioneering advanced autonomous agentic planning, multi-file code refactoring, and self-correction protocols.

details.name: GPT-6 Astra
details.meta: 2026.09 Release · OpenAI Proprietary · Long-Horizon Autonomous Reasoning
details.desc: OpenAI's breakthrough Autumn 2026 flagship model. Dominates Olympiad-level mathematics and multi-agent game-theoretic planning, featuring full self-directed execution with robust safety and alignment guardrails.

details.name: DeepSeek-V4-Pro
details.meta: 2026.08 Release · Open Weights / 1.6T MoE · Industrial Open-Source Frontier
details.desc: DeepSeek's 1.6 Trillion parameter MoE (49B active) released with open weights. The 0813 revision achieved 80.6%-95.2% on SWE-bench Verified, delivering parity with top-tier proprietary models at unprecedented cost efficiency.

details.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
details.meta: 2026.05 Release · OpenAI Proprietary · Enterprise Agentic Coding Workhorse
details.desc: OpenAI's high-efficiency workhorse for professional software engineering. Combines fast 110 t/s generation with an 86.4% SWE-bench resolution rate, powering enterprise continuous integration pipelines.

details.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
details.desc: Google's ultra-low latency model engineered for interactive and agentic microservices. Features 240+ t/s throughput and sub-120ms time-to-first-token across a native 2-million token multimodal context window.

details.name: Qwen3.8-Max
details.desc: Alibaba's September 2026 flagship model, highly tuned for full-stack software development, repository orchestration, and bilingual Chinese/English instruction following, commanding the LMSYS WebDev sub-arena.

projects.p1_desc: An open-source AI coding assistant designed for fully local execution, offering a Claude Code-like experience. Features single-process direct calls, seamless multi-model support (Google/OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama), and 39 built-in tools.
projects.p2_desc: Full-cycle commercial project: An e-commerce platform for personalized 3D printed figurines and art custom gifts. Primarily responsible for building the AI image generation pipeline, orchestrating the overall AI workflow, and conducting in-depth effect tuning to deliver a highly customizable, commercial-grade image generation engine.
projects.p3_desc: The open-source code for this site, based on a minimalist SSG approach, supporting Markdown rendering, bilingual interface, and responsive sci-fi UI.
projects.p4_desc: A lightweight object detection and tracking system built with PyTorch and YOLO, optimized for edge computing devices to achieve millisecond-level high-precision real-time inference.
projects.p5_desc: Internal full-stack project: A Python-based end-to-end smart campus system covering everything from front-end camera video stream ingestion, AI algorithm inference, to back-end automated alert triggering and multi-channel notifications.
projects.p6_desc: An interactive tabular data analysis tool. Supports uploading CSV or Excel files, with an Agent automatically inspecting and querying data to generate analysis reports with interactive charts. Built with Vue3, ECharts, and Go.
